name: Mashhad
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: 14.6 cm/yr LOS and 19.1 cm/yr vertical max (2014-2017 Sentinel-1 PSInSAR); 20 to 30 cm/yr peak Envisat InSAR (1995-2005)
literature_sources: Motagh, M. et al. (2007), Geophysical Journal International, https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1365-246X.2006.03246.x
Extreme subsidence in a populated city (Mashhad) detected by PSInSAR, Scientific Reports (2020), https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7347893/
agreement_note: Consistent: 120-day summer NISAR signal (-8.6 cm LOS, -11.3 cm vertical estimate, -7.2 cm/100d) represents ~0.6 of a published 19.1 cm/yr vertical year in peak irrigation season. Smooth accumulation across 9 pairs, 70.5% valid pixels, ref spread [-8.6, -6.0] cm (ratio 0.30).
press_summary_gate_note: Approved for atlas #2 rank (passed tools/atlas_qc.py, 70.5% valid pixels, consistent with 14.6-19.1 cm/yr published PSInSAR rates).
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
